description: A sticky index of topics with question counts beside the questions grouped under each topic.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Jump to a topic, or scroll through the whole list. We update it every month.

questions.question: How long does setup take?
questions.answer: About ten minutes. Connect your calendar and video tool, and Fieldnote joins the next interview you schedule.

questions.question: Can we import past interviews?
questions.answer: Yes. Upload audio or video files, or connect a cloud drive, and they are transcribed like new ones.

questions.question: How accurate are transcripts?
questions.answer: Around 95% on clear audio, with every speaker labelled. You can correct any line in place.

questions.question: Which languages are supported?
questions.answer: Thirty-two, including French, Spanish, German and Japanese. Calls that switch languages work too.

questions.question: Can I record in-person sessions?
questions.answer: Use the mobile app to record on your phone, then the upload lands in the right project.

questions.question: Do participants know they are recorded?
questions.answer: Always. Fieldnote announces itself when it joins, and a consent note goes out with every invite.

questions.question: Where is our data stored?
questions.answer: In the region you choose: Canada, the US or the EU. Everything is encrypted at rest and in transit.

questions.question: Do viewers need a paid seat?
questions.answer: No. Anyone who only reads and comments is free, on every plan.

questions.question: What happens when the trial ends?
questions.answer: Nothing is deleted. Pick a plan to keep recording, or stay on Starter to keep reading.
